title: Authentication and session lifecycle
static_method: Enumerate sign-in, recovery/access-key, session and logout/revocation routes from code/config. Identify backend verification and expiry rules.
dynamic_method: With disposable users, compare valid access with missing, malformed, expired and revoked credentials; attempt old-session reuse after logout and after account disable.
pass_criteria: Authorized case works; rejected requests disclose no scoped data and cause no protected write; terminated sessions remain unusable according to documented contract.
budget: 10 min; at most 20 requests per case
limits: No expiry feature assumed; document any persistent-key design and its risk. Proxy authentication requires an actual verified boundary.

title: Function and data authorization
trigger: Accounts/scoped data, APIs, stream or export
static_method: Map subject-role/data scope to each read/write route, event stream, export and admin action. Trace server-side enforcement and stale asynchronous result handling.
dynamic_method: Use two synthetic subjects with disjoint host/project scopes plus administrator. Replay a permitted request under the other identity and after scope/revocation change; include an already-open stream.
pass_criteria: No unauthorized object/function response, persisted mutation or post-revocation stale disclosure; equivalent scopes consistent across UI/API/export.
limits: Do not invent tenant boundaries. If no tenant exists, tenant isolation is NOT_APPLICABLE with architecture evidence.

title: Untrusted data to browser and interpreter
trigger: Untrusted labels, queries, templates or child processes
static_method: Trace event labels, filenames and query input to HTML/URL/SQL/process sinks; inspect parameterization and context-specific handling.
dynamic_method: Render inert marker strings containing delimiter/markup characters in disposable fixtures and verify visible text/DOM; exercise a rejected malformed query without executing host commands.
pass_criteria: Input is treated as data in the intended context; no unexpected navigation, executable markup or altered query/process structure.
budget: 10 min; no payload against live service
limits: Static suspicion is not a demonstrated exploit; a safe textContent path does not prove all other sinks safe.

title: Browser origin and deployment boundary
static_method: Inventory cookie/storage auth, CSRF-relevant mutations, CORS, CSP, frame policy, Host/Origin handling, proxy headers and bind/TLS defaults.
dynamic_method: In isolated instance compare intended origin/host with foreign/missing/mismatched values as permitted by protocol; check preflight, framing and ambient-credential state changes where present.
pass_criteria: Documented trust boundary enforced; response headers fit actual content/workflow; foreign origin cannot cause protected action or read sensitive response.
limits: Header presence alone is insufficient. Local loopback HTTP may be intentional; do not force internet-service HSTS assumptions onto it.

title: Filesystem paths and reviewed exports
trigger: File access, exports, ZIPs or generated downloads
static_method: Identify allowed roots and links/reparse points; inspect path construction, normalization, symlink policy, extraction destinations, review authorization and exported field allowlist.
dynamic_method: Use a disposable tree with sentinel files outside allowed root and hostile/ambiguous filenames; create a small export and independently inspect members/fields/hashes. If CSV is supported, inspect formula-leading cells.
pass_criteria: No read/write outside scope, secret/unrelated content, invalid archive path or unreviewed field; download names safe; spreadsheet interpretation mitigated where applicable.
limits: No extraction of unknown hostile archives in production. Formula protection is conditional, not a mandate to add spreadsheet export.

title: Outbound requests and integration credentials
trigger: HTTP fetch, API integration or archive transport
static_method: Inventory destinations, redirect handling, DNS/proxy assumptions, TLS verification, credential injection scope and integration defaults.
dynamic_method: Use mock endpoints to compare approved destination and refused foreign/redirect/TLS failure; simulate provider rate limit, expired auth and unavailable permission.
pass_criteria: No credential sent before identity/destination validation or to unintended redirect; TLS fails closed; partial/unavailable remains visible with bounded retry.
limits: Do not request real cloud metadata or unrelated hosts; no credential expansion/account provisioning to make a test pass.

title: Collector identity and semantic ingestion
basis: ASVS v5.0.0-2.2.1 and 8.3.1 plus product contract
static_method: Trace enrollment, instance/host/project/source identity, source schema versions and cursor/ACK logic; identify totals' identity basis and timestamp semantics.
dynamic_method: Send known synthetic valid, wrong-instance/host, malformed, stale/future, duplicate, reordered and corrected-version batches; restart between lost-ACK retry and resend.
pass_criteria: Correct source scope, deterministic duplicate/correction treatment, no invented totals; rejected/uncommitted input does not advance cursor; previous exact retry has documented idempotency.
limits: Require only ordering/replay guarantees the protocol promises; preserve provenance and show gaps rather than fabricate continuity.

title: Reconnect and bounded resource pressure
trigger: Streams, parsers, queues or history workload
static_method: Read size/count/decompression/time/concurrency/storage limits and overload policy; distinguish capture preservation from rendering bounds.
dynamic_method: Disconnect/reconnect a viewer and collector, use slow reader plus bounded burst just above a configured limit, then release pressure. Compare committed fixture counts before/after.
pass_criteria: No silent loss, retry storm or unbounded growth; clear stale/gap/backpressure state; documented recovery cursor and bounded workload/latency behavior.
limits: No uncontrolled DoS or disk filling; use quotas or failure injection. Model worker resource use separately from product workload.

title: Archive transaction and exact receipt custody
basis: ASVS v5.0.0-2.3.3; SQLite practice; product custody rules
static_method: Trace row version to outbox/segment, receiver/catalog commit, receipt verification and eviction. Identify rebuildable indexes versus original source.
dynamic_method: Interrupt before/after write/ACK, lose ACK, retry same/different bytes, supply foreign/partial/corrupt receipt or segment; concurrently correct one record version.
pass_criteria: Only exact current durably accepted versions become eligible for eviction; corrupt/foreign/partial evidence rejected; originals retained; retry has defined semantics.
limits: No deleting production records or resetting queues. Durable receipt assumptions include filesystem/transport boundaries, not just hash equality.

title: Coherent backups migrations and restore
basis: SQLite Online Backup API; engineering judgment
static_method: Document snapshot consistency across databases/config/identity, exclusions, migration versions, rollback policy and restore trust behavior.
dynamic_method: Backup a disposable representative instance via supported method, restore to an isolated root and compare schema, selected logical rows, provenance/receipts and application reads; simulate one migration failure.
pass_criteria: Actual recovery succeeds within agreed RTO/RPO; unsupported downgrade safely refuses; original only copy untouched; credentials not silently rebound.
budget: 30 min initial fixture; cap by declared volume
limits: A backup existing or database integrity check is not a successful application restore; real NAS durability remains separate evidence.

title: Privacy logging diagnostics and telemetry
trigger: All outputs; consent path if implemented
static_method: Enumerate capture/diagnostic/log/export/telemetry fields and destinations, retention and access; inspect error observability and redaction before queueing.
dynamic_method: Inject synthetic prohibited markers, trigger one refusal/error and inspect outputs/state. Where telemetry exists, test fresh off/consent/on/disable/queued-report behavior with mock receiver.
pass_criteria: No prohibited values in saved/transmitted outputs; actionable redacted errors; default-off and disposal rules match consent contract.
limits: Do not label data anonymous solely because names are omitted; receiver metadata still matters. Feature absent stays NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

title: Dependencies build and private release configuration
basis: Scorecard checks; GitHub secure use; SLSA
static_method: Inventory exact direct/transitive/runtime/asset versions and sources, lock/install scripts, dynamic downloads, build credentials, workflow authority and artifact inclusions.
dynamic_method: When separately authorized, run declared dependency/secret/static checks on the frozen input and inspect results; compare actual artifact members to inventory; validate trusted build/source identity.
pass_criteria: No unexplained included dependency/secret; applicable advisories triaged with impact/reachability; privileged workflow exposure resolved; coverage/permission limits explicit.
budget: 30 min; one approved tool pass plus triage
limits: No scans performed by this research. A tool score or clean pattern scan is not proof of source integrity or application security.
